cohort: 50 infants with bowel atresia and 100 matched controls
finding: Unlike western countries, esophageal atresia was the most common type of bowel atresia with no gender differences and a high rate of low birth weight in both cases and controls.
mod_finding: One mother of the control group had a cesarean section in comparison to 15 mothers from the cases (OR 42.4; 95% CI 5.4-333.09).
birth_weight: 26 (51%) of the cases were having below normal birth weight
